dog.description_text:
Meet Rhylee!

We’re so excited to welcome Rylee into foster care with Every Last One Rescue, This girl is a whole lot of joy in one petite pup, and everyone she meets is instantly a friend.

Rylee is ALWAYS happy, she walks nicely on leash, is potty trained, and was a total volunteer favorite at the shelter. She’s been collecting fans everywhere she goes.

Now she’s getting her chance to settle into foster care, and we can’t wait to learn more about her!
dog.name: Rhylee
